_: Pillar: the frame’s primary member. A Ø10 body 36 long between the motor plate and the rail plate, with an M8 end at each — the threads take the grip tension, the shoulders set the plate spacing and take the compression. It also pierces its pivot arm, so it is the plunger’s alignment rail and its anti-rotation. Two per gripper, on the grip plane at x ±24. Threads are modelled at their minor diameter. One revolve about local Z, placed along +Y.
